value.body:
We cannot expose implementation details to Customer. "id" should be interpreted as one unit. Current implementation with encoded value just a workaround until UUID will be introduced in Magento (see details in https://github.com/magento/architecture/blob/master/design-documents/graph-ql/coverage/add-items-to-cart-single-mutation.md#options)

Maybe we can log it just for debug purpose and throw a generic error message aka "Provided option %1 is not valid product with SKU %2". I think log details is acceptable and will help/save time during debug. @akaplya  what do you think?
